public_rationale: OpenAI reports an $852 billion financing valuation and more than one billion weekly active users. Those are substantial signs of scale and prevent dismissing the forecast. But Zitron supplied neither a deadline nor a measure defining equivalence with Google or Meta. Treating valuation or audience alone as decisive would make the result depend on an added interpretation. No conclusive event establishes the forecast's success or failure under the stated rule.
limitations: The operating and valuation figures are company disclosures.
The forecast's subjective exclusivity cannot be independently measured.
The evidence does not justify treating continued growth or nonarrival by the evaluation date as a final outcome.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI is the only current company Zitron would expect to grow to the scale of Google or Meta.
conditions: only current company he would expect to do so

statement.excerpt: Altman was clearly gunning for scale, and to turn OpenAI into the name synonymous with “AI,” and to be at the helm of the only current company I would expect to grow to the scale of a Google or Meta.

from_speaker: the only current company I would expect
grow to the scale of a Google or Meta
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that OpenAI could become a comparably large technology business. The statement supplies no particular financial or operating measure.
The exclusivity concerns Zitron's expectation, not a claim that every other company will fail.
No deadline is stated. Revenue, valuation and audience size are possible indicators, but choosing any one as sufficient would add a rule the speaker did not supply.
Metric scope is null because the claim specifies overall business scale rather than a particular money metric.
criteria.support_condition: Public records establish comparability with Google or Meta in overall business scale, without the result depending entirely on an unstated choice of measure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: OpenAI permanently ceases operating before attaining that scale. Remaining smaller at an arbitrary evaluation date is insufficient.

evidence.explanation: This establishes a substantial private financing valuation. It does not establish an agreed measure of Google- or Meta-like business scale.
